description: CMS-1500 / HCFA-1500 health insurance claim form (NUCC 02-12 and older layouts) used by US providers to bill professional services: patient and insured information (items 1-13) and physician or supplier information with up to six service lines (items 14-33).

supplemental_information.instruction: Text printed in the SHADED upper row of this service line (e.g. NDC 'N4 00186071801 UN1.000', anesthesia time 'ZZ...', or 'NPI ...'). Never copy shaded-row text into the other service-line fields.

service_start_date.instruction: Item 24A From date of the UNSHADED lower row. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

service_end_date.instruction: Item 24A To date of the unshaded lower row. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

place_of_service.instruction: Item 24B place of service exactly as written, normally a 2-digit code such as 11, 02 or 12. Do not infer.

emg_indicator.instruction: Item 24C EMG value (Y or blank) on 02-12 forms. On older HCFA forms column C is Type of Service; return that value.

procedure_code.instruction: Item 24D CPT/HCPCS code only (5 characters, e.g. 99214 or A4649). Exclude modifiers and any description text.

procedure_modifier.instruction: Item 24D MODIFIER boxes: all modifiers (up to 4) separated by single spaces in the order written, e.g. '25 95'. Empty if none.

procedure_description.instruction: Any description written next to the code in item 24D (common on older forms, e.g. '97810/Acupuncture'). Empty if none.

diagnosis_code.instruction: Item 24E DIAGNOSIS POINTER exactly as written: letters A-L on 02-12 forms (e.g. 'ABC') or digits 1-4 on older forms. Not an ICD code.

charge_amount.instruction: Item 24F charge: combine the dollars and cents boxes, e.g. '125 | 35' is 125.35.

units.instruction: Item 24G days or units as a number.

epsdt_family_plan.instruction: Item 24H EPSDT/Family Plan value, empty if blank.

rendering_provider_id_qualifier.instruction: Item 24I ID qualifier in the SHADED half of the line, e.g. 0B or 1G. Empty if blank. The printed label 'NPI' is not a value.

rendering_provider_other_id.instruction: Item 24J SHADED upper half: rendering provider non-NPI ID. Empty if blank.

rendering_provider_npi.instruction: Item 24J UNSHADED lower half: the 10-digit rendering provider NPI written for THIS line. Empty if blank. Never use an NPI from a shaded supplemental row or another line.

insurance_program.instruction: Item 1 (top-left row): seven small boxes, each directly to the LEFT of a program ID label, in this order: (Medicare#)=MEDICARE, (Medicaid#)=MEDICAID, (ID#/DoD#)=TRICARE, (Member ID#)=CHAMPVA, (ID#) under GROUP HEALTH PLAN=GROUP_HEALTH_PLAN, (ID#) under FECA BLK LUNG=FECA_BLK_LUNG, (ID#) under OTHER=OTHER. Return the program whose box contains an X or check mark. The very first box at the far left belongs to MEDICARE. Return NONE if no box is marked.

insured_id_number.instruction: Item 1a insured's ID number exactly as written.

patient_name.instruction: Item 2 patient name as written, 'Last, First, Middle Initial'.

patient_date_of_birth.instruction: Item 3 patient's birth date (MM DD YY boxes). Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

patient_sex.instruction: Item 3 SEX: return F or M for the marked box, empty if neither is marked.

insured_name.instruction: Item 4 insured's name as written, 'Last, First, Middle Initial'.

patient_address.instruction: Item 5 street, city, state and ZIP joined as one line.

patient_phone_number.instruction: Item 5 telephone including area code, e.g. (206) 555-0100.

patient_relationship_to_insured.instruction: Item 6: SELF, SPOUSE, CHILD or OTHER for the marked box; empty if none marked.

insured_address.instruction: Item 7 street, city, state and ZIP joined as one line.

other_insured_name.instruction: Item 9 other insured's name, empty if blank.

other_insured_policy_number.instruction: Item 9a other insured's policy or group number, empty if blank.

other_insured_plan_name.instruction: Item 9d other insurance plan or program name, empty if blank.

condition_related_to_employment.instruction: Item 10a 'EMPLOYMENT? (Current or Previous)': there are two small square boxes, each immediately to the LEFT of its printed label 'YES' or 'NO'. Look inside each box: return YES if the box before the word YES contains an X or check mark, NO if the box before the word NO contains an X or check mark, NOT_MARKED if both boxes are empty.

condition_related_to_auto_accident.instruction: Item 10b 'AUTO ACCIDENT?': there are two small square boxes, each immediately to the LEFT of its printed label 'YES' or 'NO'. Look inside each box: return YES if the box before the word YES contains an X or check mark, NO if the box before the word NO contains an X or check mark, NOT_MARKED if both boxes are empty.

auto_accident_state.instruction: Item 10b PLACE (State) two-letter code, empty if blank.

condition_related_to_other_accident.instruction: Item 10c 'OTHER ACCIDENT?': there are two small square boxes, each immediately to the LEFT of its printed label 'YES' or 'NO'. Look inside each box: return YES if the box before the word YES contains an X or check mark, NO if the box before the word NO contains an X or check mark, NOT_MARKED if both boxes are empty.

claim_codes.instruction: Item 10d claim codes, empty if blank.

insured_policy_feca_number.instruction: Item 11 insured's policy group or FECA number.

insured_date_of_birth.instruction: Item 11a insured's date of birth. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

insured_sex.instruction: Item 11a SEX: M or F for the marked box (an X or check mark), empty if none.

other_claim_id.instruction: Item 11b other claim ID, empty if blank.

insured_insurance_plan_name.instruction: Item 11c insurance plan name or program name.

another_health_benefit_plan_indicator.instruction: Item 11d 'IS THERE ANOTHER HEALTH BENEFIT PLAN?': there are two small square boxes, each immediately to the LEFT of its printed label 'YES' or 'NO'. Look inside each box: return YES if the box before the word YES contains an X or check mark, NO if the box before the word NO contains an X or check mark, NOT_MARKED if both boxes are empty.

patient_signature_present.instruction: Item 12: YES if a signature or 'Signature on File'/'SOF' is present on the SIGNED line, otherwise NO.

patient_signed_date.instruction: Item 12 DATE next to the patient's signature. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

insured_signature_present.instruction: Item 13: YES if a signature or 'Signature on File'/'SOF' is present, otherwise NO. Item 13 has no date.

illness_injury_date.instruction: Item 14 date of current illness, injury or pregnancy. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

illness_injury_date_qualifier.instruction: Item 14 QUAL code (e.g. 431 onset, 484 LMP), empty if blank.

other_date.instruction: Item 15 other date. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

other_date_qualifier.instruction: Item 15 QUAL code, e.g. 439, empty if blank.

unable_to_work_start_date.instruction: Item 16 FROM date. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

unable_to_work_end_date.instruction: Item 16 TO date. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

referring_provider_name.instruction: Item 17 name of referring provider or other source, without the qualifier.

referring_provider_qualifier.instruction: Item 17 qualifier to the left of the name (DN, DK or DQ), empty if blank.

referring_provider_other_id_qualifier.instruction: Item 17a shaded qualifier, e.g. 0B or 1G, empty if blank.

referring_provider_other_id.instruction: Item 17a other ID value next to the qualifier, empty if blank.

referring_provider_npi.instruction: Item 17b NPI of the referring provider (10 digits), empty if blank.

hospitalization_start_date.instruction: Item 18 FROM date. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

hospitalization_end_date.instruction: Item 18 TO date. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

additional_claim_information.instruction: Item 19 additional claim information, empty if blank.

is_outside_lab_indicator.instruction: Item 20 'OUTSIDE LAB?': there are two small square boxes, each immediately to the LEFT of its printed label 'YES' or 'NO'. Look inside each box: return YES if the box before the word YES contains an X or check mark, NO if the box before the word NO contains an X or check mark, NOT_MARKED if both boxes are empty.

icd_indicator.instruction: Item 21 ICD Ind. value: 0 for ICD-10 or 9 for ICD-9.

diagnosis_1.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line A. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 1. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_2.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line B. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 2. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_3.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line C. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 3. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_4.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line D. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 4. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_5.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line E. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 5. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_6.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line F. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 6. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_7.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line G. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 7. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_8.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line H. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 8. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_9.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line I. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 9. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_10.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line J. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 10. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_11.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line K. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 11. Empty if blank.

diagnosis_12.instruction: Item 21 diagnosis on line L. Return only the ICD code (e.g. J44.9), no description. On older forms numbered 1-4, line 12. Empty if blank.

resubmission_code.instruction: Item 22 resubmission code (7 replacement or 8 void), empty if blank.

original_reference_number.instruction: Item 22 original reference number, empty if blank.

prior_authorization_number.instruction: Item 23 prior authorization number, empty if blank.

medical_procedures.instruction: Item 24: one entry per numbered service line 1-6 that has a procedure code or charge in its unshaded lower row. Each line has a shaded upper row (supplemental information) and an unshaded lower row (the service). Skip empty lines.

tax_id_number.instruction: Item 25 federal tax ID number, empty if blank.

tax_id_type.instruction: Item 25: SSN or EIN for the marked box, empty if none marked.

patient_account_number.instruction: Item 26 patient's account number, empty if blank.

accept_assignment.instruction: Item 27 'ACCEPT ASSIGNMENT?': there are two small square boxes, each immediately to the LEFT of its printed label 'YES' or 'NO'. Look inside each box: return YES if the box before the word YES contains an X or check mark, NO if the box before the word NO contains an X or check mark, NOT_MARKED if both boxes are empty.

total_charges.instruction: Item 28 total charge: combine dollars and cents, e.g. '753 | 22' is 753.22.

amount_paid.instruction: Item 29 amount paid: combine dollars and cents.

physician_signature_present.instruction: Item 31: YES if a signature, typed name or 'Signature on File' is present, otherwise NO.

physician_name.instruction: Item 31 signer's name as written, e.g. 'Carlos Salazar MD'.

physician_signed_date.instruction: Item 31 DATE. Return as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert MM DD YY or MM/DD/YYYY; a 2-digit year YY means 20YY. Leave empty if blank.

service_facility_name.instruction: Item 32 service facility name, empty if blank.

service_facility_address.instruction: Item 32 facility address as one line, empty if blank.

service_facility_npi.instruction: Item 32a facility NPI, empty if blank.

billing_provider_name.instruction: Item 33 billing provider name, empty if blank.

billing_provider_address.instruction: Item 33 billing provider address as one line, empty if blank.

billing_provider_phone.instruction: Item 33 PH # telephone, empty if blank.

billing_provider_npi.instruction: Item 33a billing provider NPI (10 digits), empty if blank. The faint printed word 'NPI' is a label, not a value.

billing_provider_other_id.instruction: Item 33b billing provider other ID with qualifier, empty if blank.
